expected.finding: **[P2]** The new Markdown regex has quadratic runtime on unmatched opening brackets ([line 327](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:327)). Each `[` causes another scan of the remaining input. Tokenizing 8,000, 16,000, and 32,000 brackets took 0.228, 0.899, and 3.600 seconds respectively. Long findings can stall policy revision; the existing long-word test misses this case. Use a linear scanner and test unmatched delimiters.

**[P2]** Punctuation stripping breaks recognition of `.github` paths ([line 304](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:304)). Removing the leading dot prevents matching the `.github` directory root. Consequently, `.github/actions` and `.github/CODEOWNERS` leak location tokens: two findings containing either path produce an `actions` or `codeowners` topic. Preserve leading dots when normalizing paths.
